configurations.//: autoPort is false because port 3000 is not incidental here. The API's CORS allowlist names http://localhost:3000 explicitly - see resolveAllowedOrigins in backend/src/config/env.js and CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS in backend/.env.example. On any other port the browser blocks every API call, and per the comment in LoginPage.jsx that failure surfaces to the user as 'invalid email or password' rather than as a CORS problem. Free the port instead of moving off it.
